newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria places 3.0 bln levs 82-day coupon T-bills.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria places 3.0 bln levs 82-day coupon T-bills.

text.p: Bulgaria's Finance Ministry placed 3.016 billion levs of 82-day floater coupon T-bills, yielding 68.24 percent until maturity, the central bank (BNB) said.
The coupon was set at 6/5 of the BNB's central interest rate (CIR) for the period to maturity.
The CIR is now set at historic high 25 percent monthly or 300 percent annually.
In line with its usual practice the BNB did not say with which financial institution or institutions the issue was placed.
